findings.resolution: In tools/boundary/graph.mjs, isDirectEdgeAllowed no longer short-circuits to true when sourceNode === targetNode; it now only returns true when targetNode is in DIRECT_EDGES[sourceNode]. Because §14.5 declares no apps→apps or tools→tools direct edge, cross-workspace imports between distinct workspaces sharing the same architecture node (e.g., desktop-main → desktop-preload, tools-replay → tools-bench) now produce a violation. In tools/boundary/lib.mjs the `if (target.node === ws.node && target.kind === 'package') continue;` bypass was removed; same-workspace imports remain allowed via the pre-existing `target.pkgName === ws.pkgName` short-circuit, which covers both self-package specifiers and intra-workspace relative imports. Added tests in tests/boundary/graph.test.mjs: (a) graph-level assertions that apps/tools/core/domain self-edges are rejected; (b) rejection of `@ciclo/desktop-main` importing `@ciclo/desktop-preload`; (c) rejection of relative `apps/desktop/renderer` → `apps/desktop/simulation-worker`; (d) rejection of `@ciclo/tools-replay` importing `@ciclo/tools-bench`; (e) rejection of relative tools-replay → tools-package; (f) acceptance of a package self-import inside the same workspace. Declared direct edges (domain→core, application→domain, adapters→application, ui→contracts, apps→adapters, etc.) remain accepted by the existing positive tests plus the committed-repository sweep, which continues to pass.

notes_for_reviewer: The fix intentionally rejects same-node cross-workspace imports for both `apps` and `tools`, matching the review's explicit instruction not to invent tools dependency permissions where §14.5 leaves them unresolved. If future §14.5 clarification introduces an intra-node edge (e.g., apps→apps), it would need to be added explicitly to DIRECT_EDGES.

Intra-workspace imports (both relative and self-package specifier) remain permitted via the pre-existing `target.pkgName === ws.pkgName` short-circuit in tools/boundary/lib.mjs; a new positive test locks that behavior in.
Violation reason strings were expanded to distinguish same-node cross-workspace edges from cross-node undeclared edges, aiding future debugging without changing pass/fail semantics.
payload.summary: Fixed the boundary checker to distinguish workspace identity from architecture-node identity: removed the same-node auto-allow bypass in tools/boundary/lib.mjs and the implicit self-edge in tools/boundary/graph.mjs::isDirectEdgeAllowed. Same-workspace imports (relative or self-package) remain accepted via the existing pkgName equality check. Added six negative tests covering package and relative imports between distinct same-node app workspaces (desktop-main/preload, renderer/simulation-worker) and same-node tool workspaces (tools-replay/bench, tools-replay/package), plus a positive same-workspace self-package import test and a graph-level test asserting that apps/tools/core/domain do not have implicit self-edges. §14.5 direct edges (apps→adapters, apps→contracts, apps→ui, etc.) remain unchanged; no tools dependency permissions were invented.
